data.name: Sample_IntroCentral
data.value:
What is a Mind Map?
And what is MindBuzz?

data.name: Sample_IntroNote
data.value:
## Welcome!
A mind map puts **one idea in the middle** and lets everything that belongs to it branch out around it. You see the whole picture at a glance, and every detail has its place.
Read this map clockwise, starting at the top right. Then look at the second tab, **Weekend in Lisbon**, for a real example.

data.name: Sample_ShortWords
data.value: Keep it short: a few words per topic

data.name: Sample_NotesNote
data.value:
Notes hold whatever is too long for a topic: ideas, minutes, *checklists*.
- [x] Write a note - [ ] Switch between **Edit** and **Preview**
The small page icon on a topic shows that it has a note.

data.comment: {0} a key, e.g. Enter

data.comment: {0} a key, e.g. Insert or ⌘↩

data.name: Sample_KeyEdit

data.name: Sample_Drag
data.value: Drag a topic to move it

data.name: Sample_TripNote
data.value:
Planning a trip is a perfect first mind map: everything to think of, at one glance.
- The **1** in a circle marks what must be done first. - The **bar** shows progress: the flights are booked, packing has just started. - The **lines** connect things across branches: the flights belong in the budget, and the day trip needs good shoes.
